requires: Gen2 MPC (aarch64), MPC OS 3.10.1 or newer; hardware tested on MPC Live III only
about: Percussion synthesizer for Gen2 MPCs:16 independent pad sounds, three layers and nine oscillators per sound, touch-editable envelopes, tap-to-preview WAV import and118 native MPC programs including109 original factory presets/kits. Hardware tested on Live III; see repository for exact validation, benchmark results and known limitations.
